map.镜框尺寸与瞳距计算器 使用指南: Frame size and PD calculator user guide
map.镜框尺寸与瞳距计算器依据镜圈宽、鼻梁宽与瞳距求单眼移心量与最小镜片直径，辅助镜架: The frame size and PD calculator derives monocular decentration and the minimum lens diameter from lens width, bridge width and PD, supporting frame selection and dispensing parameters.
map.配镜按双眼瞳距定光学中心距。: In dispensing, set the optical center distance from the binocular pupillary distance.
map.镜架几何中心常与瞳距差需移心。: The geometric center of the frame usually differs from the pupillary distance, requiring decentration.
map.移心误差致棱镜效应。: Decentration error causes a prism effect.
map.：瞳距 PD=64mm、镜架几何中心距 70mm → 每片内移 (70−64)/: : PD = 64 mm and frame geometric center distance 70 mm -> each lens moves inward by (70 - 64)/2 = 3 mm; if the lens is not decentered accordingly, a base-out prism effect results.
map.：每 1mm 移心、−3.00D 产生 0.3Δ 棱镜，超 2mm 明显视物偏斜: : Every 1 mm of decentration with -3.00 D produces 0.3 prism diopters; beyond 2 mm the image shift becomes noticeable, requiring precise decentration or a narrower frame.
map.为什么镜架要合瞳距？: Why must the frame match the pupillary distance?
map.光学中心不对准瞳孔会产生棱镜效应致视疲劳/斜看，PD 与架距差大必须移心或换架。: If the optical center is not aligned with the pupil, a prism effect causes visual fatigue or squinting; a large difference between PD and frame distance requires decentration or a different frame.
map.单眼瞳距也要测？: Must monocular PD also be measured?
map.要。双眼 PD 均分不总对，尤其脸不对称，渐进片必测单眼 PD 与高度。: Yes. Splitting binocular PD evenly is not always correct, especially with an asymmetric face; progressive lenses require measuring monocular PD and height.
